title: Right conjugate of the normalized scalar associator
statement: For any scheme T and unital maps A -> B -> C of commutative rings, the right-adjoint conjugate of the inverse prescribed scalarExtensionFunctor_composition is the canonical derived restriction-composition comparison. No coefficient flatness or finiteness is assumed.

proof.text: Bundle the published ordinary tensor functors and universal derived pairs into presentations. Ordinary tensor-unit uniqueness and the Hom comparison evaluated at the identity identify the normalized adjunctions with the published pbc adjunctions. The ordinary associator has the balanced pure-tensor formula, so uniqueness identifies it with reductionBalance. The derived representative equation is exactly the defining K-flat normalization of scalarExtensionFunctor_composition; its uniqueness identifies the derived comparisons. The conjugate of the normalized composite left-adjoint comparison is restriction composition. Ordinary restriction comparisons are identical on sections, hence equal; localizing identifies their derived comparisons.

from.place: Step 3: identify the specified scalar associator by its unit normalization

lean.statement: theorem scalarAssociatorConjugate {A B C : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C) (T : Scheme.{u}) : conjugateEquiv ((proEtaleRingDerivedExtensionAdjunction (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := T) φ)).comp (proEtaleRingDerivedExtensionAdjunction (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := T) ψ))) (proEtaleRingDerivedExtensionAdjunction (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := T) (ψ.comp φ))) (scalarExtensionFunctor_composition φ ψ T).inv = (pbcDerivedRestrictComp _ _ _ (scalarExtensionFunctor_ringMap_comp φ ψ T)).hom
